sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — PS5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.short: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own.
trophies.guide:
1. Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks by itself the moment the last one pops [1][5].
2. No multiplayer or DLC is needed — the whole list is single-player [1][3].
3. Play in roadmap order: story first (S1–S5), then the 100% checklist (S6), then cleanup (S7) [1][6].

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.short: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing.
trophies.guide:
1. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the mission ends [1][5].
2. It is automatic and unmissable — it unlocks as the story plays [1][2].

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 1.
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the start of Chapter 2 [1][2].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 2.
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 2; it pops at the start of Chapter 3 [1][2].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 3.
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 3; it pops at the start of Chapter 4 [1][2].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.short: Finish Chapter 4.
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 4; it pops at the start of Chapter 5 [1][2].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.short: Finish the final story mission.
trophies.guide:
1. Finish the final story mission; the trophy pops with the credits [1][2].
2. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay, and free-roam continues after the credits [1][2].

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.guide:
1. Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run; the trophy pops during it [1][5].
2. Automatic and unmissable; character switching opens after this mission [1][2].

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.guide:
1. Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops during it [1][5].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
trophies.guide:
1. Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play; the trophy pops during it [1][5].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
trophies.guide:
1. Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners; the trophy pops during it [1][5].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.guide:
1. Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown; the trophy pops during it [1][5].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.short: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.guide:
1. Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops during it [1][5].
2. Automatic and unmissable [1].

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.short: Finish the 100% checklist after the story — it is closer to 60% of the game.
trophies.guide:
1. After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — the checklist appears only after the story, but progress made earlier already counts [1][3].
2. Work the checklist, not true 100%: it is closer to 60% of the game — scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, find 50 of 66 weapons [1][3][6].
3. Finish 70 of 80 challenges (the hardest 10 can be skipped), 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, and all of the robbery lines: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults [1][3].
4. Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything stays available in free-roam after the story [1][2].

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.short: Complete 250 stunts of any kind; the checklist wants 300.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete any 250 stunts; there are 397 in total across 4 kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps [1][6].
2. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to farm [1][4].
3. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots [1].
4. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 [1][3].

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.short: Try all 9 activity types once.
trophies.guide:
1. Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, performing a stunt [1].
2. Check what you have done under Touchpad > Progress > Activities [1].
3. Most types are introduced by the story or marked with blue icons when you unfog the map — you will likely finish this naturally while working on other trophies [1][3].

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.short: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in total across 12 range locations [1][6].
2. The ranges are the hardest skill trophy after A Long Road, so leave them until your Focus is levelled up [1][4].
3. Note: OutputLag groups the 42 medals into two ranges instead of 12 locations [2] — either way, the trophy needs all 42 gold medals [1][2][6].

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.short: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations.
trophies.guide:
1. Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations, 42 races in total [1][6].
2. One win per location is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 42 races [1][3].
3. Drone races are listed in the activities guide; use the fastest drone line you have [1].

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.short: Win 20 different races out of 40 locations.
trophies.guide:
1. Win 20 different races out of 40 unique race locations; winning the same race twice does not count [1][6].
2. The 100% checklist wants 30 races won, so keep racing past 20 [3].
3. Races count across cars, bikes and drones — mix types to reach 20 quickly [1].

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.short: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge after Chapter 1's Feng Shui.
trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing location marked with a purple map icon [1].
2. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge [1][2].
3. The questline stays open after the story [1].

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.short: Finish all levels of any one arcade game.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete any one of the 4 arcade games ('Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck [1].
2. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world [1].
3. You must finish all levels in the game once — beating every challenge is not required [1][2].

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.short: Finish Andy's 5 quests in Chapter 3 (Lucia only).
trophies.guide:
1. In Chapter 3, playing as Lucia, you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville — the questline marks automatically [1].
2. Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse) [1].
3. The quests stay available after the story, so nothing here is missable [1][2].

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.short: Clear Kenton's 7 shipwreck treasure dives (returns in Chapters 2–3).
trophies.guide:
1. In Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), Kenton calls you and marks himself with a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento [1].
2. He marks purple treasure-chest icons for shipwreck dives — find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back; clear 7 shipwrecks in total [1].
3. Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures [1].
4. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason; calling Brian speeds it up) — he is not missable [1][2].

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.short: Finish Billy's 5 jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Billy's questline marks at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County [1].
2. Complete his 5 jobs: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (Steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes [1].
3. All of it stays available after the story [1][2].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.short: Finish 8 counting stranger strands — only some questlines count.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but only certain questlines count: Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile) are confirmed [1][6].
2. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count — they have their own trophies or are not strangers [1][2][6].
3. Watch: PowerPyx is still confirming which other strands count, and OutputLag warns to do Yago's timed race (Race Against Yago, hourglass icon, Chapter 3) the moment it appears [1][2].
4. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish [2].

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.short: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's wish list.
trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), Randy gives you a wish list of 16 sports cars [1].
2. Steal and deliver the cars to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted — the list includes the Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D [1].
3. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; cars show up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach [1].
4. Deliveries stay open after the story [1][2].

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.short: Destroy Tyrone's Synthetic Labs, then shut them down (Jason only).
trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, Tyrone's questline marks purple Synthetic Labs in Vice City — Jason only [1].
2. Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter (Kitty Litter Labs) [1].
3. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) — finishing it pops the trophy [1].
4. Everything stays available after the story [1][2].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.short: Meditate at every spot — and do the Chapter 1 balcony one before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree on the total: PowerPyx and GTABase count 18 spots for the trophy, while the 100% checklist asks for 15 [1][4]. Both numbers are shown; neither is picked. It is also unconfirmed whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required at all — PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, and OutputLag says nobody has confirmed it [1][2]. Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide:
1. Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2 [1][2].
2. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation BEFORE Chapter 1 ends: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she says she will meditate, and choose Accept [1][2][3].
3. Track your count under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations [1].
4. The last meditation needs both characters playable together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break) [1][2].

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.short: Hunt for Bret (Jason only) — which animal counts is still unconfirmed.
trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason (Jason only) and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County [1].
2. Do Bret's quests; he marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason [1].
3. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker [1].
4. Watch: which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx says it is still being confirmed, and the 15 Target Decks (all needed for 100%) are the safer target [1][2][4].

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.short: Complete any 3 of the 18 card sets.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18 in total [1][6].
2. Card locations are listed in the collectible guides; the 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting past 3 [1][3].
3. Track sets under Progress > Collections [1].

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.short: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app.
trophies.guide:
1. Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1): any mix of 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher tags [1][6].
2. There are more than 100, so it does not matter which ones you scan [1].
3. The 100% checklist wants the same 100 scans, so this pops along the way [3].

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.short: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete 50 of the 80 challenges; there are 10 more than needed, so pick the easiest [1].
2. Track them under Progress > Challenges [1].
3. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 [1][3].

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.short: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
trophies.guide:
1. You need Jason and Lucia together — character switching opens in Chapter 2, and free-roam together after Coffee Break [1][2].
2. Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you (call them with hold Right + Triangle), then escape the red 'heat' zone — leaving the flashing search area is not enough [1][2].
3. Easiest escape: a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you [1][4].
4. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always bring 4 stars [1][2].

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.short: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, never losing the wanted level.
trophies.guide:
1. With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back while the police are still chasing you — never let the wanted level drop (stay in the red/blue flashing level, not the red heat level) [1][2].
2. Gear up first: armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, Zombix or Adrenaline for healing [1].
3. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); rob a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs [1].
4. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth [1][2].

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.short: Scan 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app.
trophies.guide:
1. Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle, hold R1 to scan) — you do not need to drive them [1][2].
2. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; the game has 557 vehicles at launch [1].
3. Track discoveries under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles [1].
4. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so keep scanning past 100 [1][3].

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.short: Drop 5 enemies in one Combat Focus activation.
trophies.guide:
1. Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming — it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar [1][2].
2. Buff focus first: eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (L1, then Triangle) to extend it [1].
3. Line up 5 enemies — gang members at illegal operations work best — and drop them in one activation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556 [1][2].
4. It does not count on soldiers, police or civilians [1][2].
5. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — you will likely reach level 4 naturally [1].

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.short: Steal a docked passenger plane at VCIA and fly 1 km away.
trophies.guide:
1. At VCIA (Vice City International Airport), steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked on the airfield do not count [1][2].
2. The easiest is at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, and board directly [1][2].
3. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away — the trophy is delayed until you are that far out [1][2].

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.short: Enter a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and shoot enemies.
trophies.guide:
1. Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County (OutputLag places it on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys) [1][2].
2. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance [1].
3. Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops [1][2].

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.short: Rob a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun, unseen.
trophies.guide:
1. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies [1][2].
2. Enter a jewelry store through the locked back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door triggers the alarm); the gadget stays in your inventory [1][2].
3. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm [1].
4. A good target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City; the trophy pops shortly after you leave [1][2].

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.short: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (8 exist for 100%).
trophies.guide:
1. Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it introduces bank vault robberies [1][2].
2. Tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open, and rob it; bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag) [1].
3. After the intro, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons) — do his earlier quests first (robbing 2 Payday Loans) [1].
4. Robbing a vault instantly gives 4 stars: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognized [1][2].
5. There are 8 large bank jobs; you need 5 for the trophy and all 8 for 100% — up to $205,000 per bank [1][6].

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.short: Rob an armored truck (or a bank vault) and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
1. It unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults — robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck [1][6].
2. Earlier method: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests) [1].
3. Either way, the trophy pops only after you escape the red 'heat' radius — use a Pay 'n' Spray if you are still hot [1].

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.short: Fully unfog the map of Leonida — fastest by plane.
trophies.guide:
1. Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — every area counts [1][2].
2. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fog patch until the map is visible [1][2][6].
3. Check the map for any remaining black-fog patches before you call it done [1].

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.short: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.guide:
1. Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist in total [1][6].
2. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many mark automatically from story progress [1].
3. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs [1].
4. The 100% checklist wants all 39, so this pops along the way [1][3].

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.short: Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar — method disputed.
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree: PowerPyx (updated most recently) gives a concrete method, while KeenGamer, eGamers and GTA-Zone still list this trophy's exact trigger as unconfirmed (as of 18 Nov) [1][3][4][6]. If the bar method does not pop it, wait for the guides to converge rather than guessing at other triggers.
trophies.guide:
1. PowerPyx's method: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar [1].
2. Disputed: KeenGamer, eGamers and GTA-Zone still list this trophy's exact trigger as unconfirmed (as of 18 Nov) — PowerPyx's page was updated after theirs [3][4][6].
3. If the bar method does not pop it, wait for the guides to converge rather than guessing at other triggers [1].

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.short: Steal the blue Banshee and drive it through the showroom window — disputed.
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree: PowerPyx (updated most recently) gives a concrete method, while KeenGamer, eGamers and GTA-Zone still list the method as unconfirmed (as of 18 Nov) [1][3][4][6]. GTA-Zone notes the description points to driving out through the window [6].
trophies.guide:
1. PowerPyx's method: steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — only that blue Banshee counts (a GTA III easter egg) [1].
2. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS [1].
3. Disputed: KeenGamer, eGamers and GTA-Zone still list the method as unconfirmed (as of 18 Nov); GTA-Zone notes the description points to driving out through the window [3][4][6].
4. The unlock is slightly delayed — it pops after you drive further away on the street [1].

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.short: Steal all 3 valuables from the Kingpin Bowling robbery.
trophies.guide:
1. Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — it comes up during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling [1][6].
2. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first: you need them to blow the safe [1].
3. Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office [1].
4. The trophy pops after you escape the police — killing enemies is not needed, and if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later so you can return for it (not missable) [1].

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.short: Max Strength with Jason AND Lucia at the same time.
trophies.guide:
1. Reach maximum Strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time [1][2].
2. Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters [1].
3. Buy a fitness-club membership and always train together — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle); while one character works out, the other completes training automatically, so progress doubles [1].
4. Find clubs via Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story [1].
5. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon) [1].

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.short: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (single source).
trophies.guide:
1. Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list [1].
2. Turn on profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On); a demon-face icon appears whenever an action counts [1].
3. Profiles run Professional (stealth, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitate, don't kill), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) — and Irredeemable, which is permanent if you keep using excessive violence [1][4].
4. It fills passively from robberies and fights; if it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops — but know cops shoot on sight more at Psycho and Irredeemable [1].
5. Single-source: the 500-action target comes from GTABase via eGamers — no second guide confirms the number [4].

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.short: Trigger unknown — believed linked to the Prologue Payday Loans store.
trophies.guide:
1. Unconfirmed: no guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue [1].
2. KeenGamer, eGamers and GTA-Zone agree it is unconfirmed — do not trust any method that claims otherwise yet [3][4][6].
3. Play the story and the Payday Loan jobs normally; this guide will be updated when the trigger is cracked [1].

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.short: Complete the UFO easter egg north-west of Starlet Motel — disputed.
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree: PowerPyx (updated most recently) gives a concrete method, while KeenGamer, eGamers and GTA-Zone still list this trophy as unconfirmed (as of 18 Nov) [1][3][4][6].
trophies.guide:
1. PowerPyx's method: complete the UFO easter egg — go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night after 2AM, alone [1].
2. If a blinking car is at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to the UFO (bright blue light in the sky); approach it, and it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside [1].
3. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed — if the car is not there, drive away and come back [1].
4. Disputed: KeenGamer, eGamers and GTA-Zone still list this trophy as unconfirmed (as of 18 Nov) [3][4][6].

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.short: Kick 10 pedestrians from a bike within 60 seconds — disputed.
trophies.disagree: Sources disagree: PowerPyx (updated most recently) gives a concrete method, while KeenGamer and eGamers still list the precise method as being confirmed ('perform the required melee drive-by elimination') [1][3][4].
trophies.guide:
1. PowerPyx's method: ride any motorcycle or push bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — do it in crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach [1].
2. Disputed: KeenGamer and eGamers still list the precise method as being confirmed ('perform the required melee drive-by elimination') [3][4].
3. If kicks do not count, try a different bike and a denser crowd rather than assuming the method is wrong [1].

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.short: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through fences (Yasmani pays most).
trophies.guide:
1. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills [1].
2. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most [1][6].
3. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one go [1][2].
4. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but only unlock after Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… [1].

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.short: Spend $100,000 across all shops — guns, mods and tattoos are fastest.
trophies.guide:
1. Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — the total is cumulative [1][2].
2. Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos, the most expensive items — the game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores [1].
3. It fills naturally while buying gear for other trophies [1].

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.short: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (~$160,000).
trophies.guide:
1. Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count) for about $160,000 in total [1][2].
2. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone [1].
3. Buy them through the app; robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to fund them [1].

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.short: Register 10 stolen vehicles through Moses in Port Gellhorn.
trophies.guide:
1. The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) [1].
2. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray, then Register [1][2].
3. Buy garages first — each one adds parking spots, and you need a free spot to register [1][2].
4. At first Moses only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray — registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes [1].
